name: Alabama

regulator.name: Alabama Athlete Agents Commission (Secretary of State)

law.name: Revised Uniform Athlete Agents Act (Ala. Code 8-26B)

covers_nil_agents: Yes. An agency contract covers endorsement deals, so NIL agents must register (Ala. Code 8-26B-2). Alabama's separate 2021 NIL law was repealed in 2022.
summary: Register with the Alabama Athlete Agents Commission. $200, good for 2 years. The Commission approves applications at quarterly meetings.

steps.text: Fill out the online Athlete Agent application
steps.detail: Signed under penalty of perjury. Upload every supporting document or it won't be processed.
$200 for a new registration. It's $100 if you already hold another state's registration.

steps.text: Submit at least 2 weeks before a Commission meeting
steps.detail: The next meeting is Dec 9, 2026. Its deadline is Nov 18, 2026.

steps.text: Register with each school's compliance office, if it asks
steps.detail: Most schools have their own agent sign-up.

steps.text: Tell the athletic director in writing before you first contact the athlete
steps.detail: This covers contact with a parent too. If the athlete reached out first, tell the athletic director within 10 days.

steps.text: Use a written contract with all required items
steps.detail: Say you're registered in Alabama and list other states where you're registered. Add your pay and how it's figured, anyone else being paid, expenses, services, length and date signed.

steps.text: Put the Warning to Student Athlete box next to their signature
steps.detail: Use the exact words below, in bold capital letters.

steps.text: Have the athlete sign a separate eligibility warning
steps.detail: It says signing may cost them their eligibility. A parent or guardian signs it if the athlete is a minor.

steps.text: Give the athlete a copy of the contract and the separate warning when they sign
Tell the athletic director in writing within 72 hours of signing
steps.detail: Or before the athlete's next game, if that comes first. The athlete must tell the athletic director too.

steps.text: Let the athlete cancel within 14 days
steps.detail: They cancel by written notice. They owe you nothing and keep anything you gave them to sign.

steps.text: Tell the new school within 72 hours if a client enrolls later
steps.detail: Count from when you knew or should have known they enrolled. If you recruited them before they enrolled and they get an athletic scholarship, tell the school within 10 days.

steps.text: Date the contract the day it's signed
steps.detail: Federal law (SPARTA) bans pre-dating or post-dating it.
Names and addresses of clients, every contract and what you spent recruiting each athlete. The Secretary of State may inspect them.

steps.text: Never give gifts or money to recruit athletes or make false promises
steps.detail: Don't give anything of value before they sign, or to anyone but the athlete or another registered agent. Never pre-date or post-date a contract.
A registration lasts 2 years. It's also $100 if you renew based on another state's renewal.

watch_list.item: Federal Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (S.4668)
watch_list.status: Passed the Senate on Sept 28, 2026. The House is out until Nov 9 and leaders say it won't pass as-is. It dies if not enacted by Jan 3, 2027.
watch_list.impact: It would require every NIL agent to register in a state, cap agent fees at 5% of an endorsement deal and limit contracts to the athlete's eligibility.

review_notes: Statute text was read on Justia's 2025 Code of Alabama and the 2016 act on the Secretary of State site. No amendments since Act 2016-415 were found. Confirm on the official code at alison.legislature.state.al.us before launch.
Penalties (Ala. Code 8-26B-15 and 8-26B-17) were not reviewed.
contract_warning: Warning to student athlete. If you sign this contract: (1) you may lose your eligibility to compete as a student athlete in your sport; (2) if you have an athletic director, within 72 hours after signing this contract or before the next scheduled athletic event in which you participate, whichever occurs first, both you and your athlete agent must notify your athletic director that you have entered into this contract and provide the name and contact information of the athlete agent; and (3) you may cancel this contract within 14 days after signing it. Cancellation of this contract may not reinstate your eligibility as a student athlete in your sport.
